answer: Assign graders by random jury. Each epoch the beacon draws 7 attesters per answer from the whole network, nobody chooses who grades them, and an answer needs 4 of 7 votes to pass. A farm holding 10% of all accounts gets a 4-seat majority on its own answer only about 0.3% of the time, so its 1,000 puppets are graded mostly by strangers. A juror who votes against a clear 5-2 result loses a 10-token bond. Puppets can't buy an oasis of friendly graders. Each answer has to cross the ridge on its own, like a juniper on bare rock.
